en: Xiangyang Kangjin Power Technology Co., Ltd.

1: Xiangyang Kangjin Power Technology Co., Ltd. Professional supplier of diesel engines and engine solutions for construction, power generation, marine, and industrial applications.
Address: Building B7, Jiahai Industrial Park, High-tech Zone, Xiangyang City, Hubei Province, China
We connect you directly to Cummins-authorized supply and factory-level engine resources.

Our core business includes diesel engine R&D, production, customization, maintenance and testing; explosion-proof engine development; Cummins spare parts supply, plus engine overhaul and testing services.
